candidates.claim: EDGE_IN on rtr-01 permits tcp/443 from any source to fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, an HTTPS path to the firewall's ASA HTTP server (enabled) from outside the MGMT zone, contrary to the policy that HTTPS/ASDM management is allowed only from MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 from EDGE_IN and keep fw-01 HTTPS/ASDM reachable only from 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/17 on sw-it-01 deviates from the approved baseline in its description line (modified, free text).
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the sw-it-01 Gi1/0/17 description change against the approved baseline and approve or revert it.
